key: “Do not develop your artificial intelligence, but develop that intelligence which is from God. From the latter, results virtue; from the former, cunning.
s: Late in Kuan Yin’s answer to Lieh Tzŭ, two kinds of knowing are contrasted; Guo Xiang, on chapter 19, reads the one from God as nature moving without forethought, content with enough, and the artificial as knowledge in use, chasing whatever stirs it endlessly.
src: Guo Xiang, Zhuangzi zhu, chapter 19, zh.wikisource (Nanhua zhenjing zhushu, juan 21, Zhengtong Daozang edition), revision 7907029 (2026)

opened.edition: zh.wikisource 南華真經註疏 卷二十一 (Zhengtong Daozang, DZ0745), revision 7907029, Cheng Xuanying’s 疏 left out
opened.locator: chapter 19, the notes on 不開人之天，而開天之天, 開天者德生 and 開人者賊生 (Giles 19.26)

evidence.words: 然則開天者，性之動也；開人者，知之用也。…性動者，遇物而當足則忘餘，斯德生也。…知用者，從感而求，劫而不已，斯賊生也。
evidence.gloss: So opening the heavenly is the movement of one’s nature; opening the human is the use of knowledge. … When nature moves, it meets things and, once matched and sufficient, forgets the rest: so virtue arises. … When knowledge is used, it follows what stirs it and seeks, driven without stopping: so harm arises.
evidence.licence: public domain text; transcription CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikisource)

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, ref Zhuangzi 19.26, at 1698). Guo Xiang’s three notes on 不開人之天，而開天之天 / 開天者德生 / 開人者賊生 carry the reading exactly: knowing without deliberation is opening the heavenly, the movement of nature, which forgets the rest once it has enough; opening the human is knowledge in use, which follows what stirs it without stopping. Changed only the sentence wording: the plain sense was a participial fragment with no subject (Closing Kuan Yin’s answer...;) and said Closing though a further sentence follows in Kuan Yin’s answer; it now reads Late in Kuan Yin’s answer to Lieh Tzŭ, two kinds of knowing are contrasted. The reading said the two as X and Y in the reverse of the verse’s order; it now names each (the one from God, the artificial) so the mapping is unambiguous. Key, ref, at and src unchanged. entry-check ok, 44 words.
